dialogues.speaker: Taher
dialogues.text: Is doing business really all that great?

dialogues.speaker: Taher
dialogues.text: I don't get what the point of selling this useless, gaudy stuff is. Maybe that's because I'm a bumpkin from the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Taher
dialogues.text: Besides, these city folks doing business don't look too happy to me, either.

dialogues.speaker: Taher
dialogues.text: Nine out of ten people who come out of the exchange look miserable, and the tenth will be bawling their eyes out.

dialogues.speaker: Taher
dialogues.text: I also hear that there are students who think they can make it big by learning a few things. They come to try their luck, but end up forking over a year's worth of living expenses. Don't be like them!

dialogues.speaker: Taher
dialogues.text: Well, I'm not keen on trying to figure them out either.
